name: hero-parallax
title: Hero Parallax
description: A full-width dark hero with a huge white headline and a short paragraph, backed by three rows of large photo cards caught in perspective. Scrolling slides the rows sideways and raises the wall upright.
use: A studio or product landing page that wants a bold headline backed by a moving wall of work.
avoid: Small screens or few images: cards are fixed at 30rem wide and fifteen are expected.
a11y: Captions and the card lift are mouse-only; links have alt text but no focus styling. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage with a large white headline and small paragraph on the left, crossed by rows of big photo cards tilted in perspective. The cards form diagonal bands of city, car and street scenes, each with a small caption at its bottom-left.
behaves: As the page scrolls, the card rows slide sideways in opposite directions while the whole block rotates upright from a steep tilt and rises into place. Hovering a card lifts it and shows its title.
customise: Pass a products array of title, link and thumbnail; row placement, the spring and the fifteen-card layout are fixed.
weight: moderate: Fifteen large photos with several spring transforms driven by scroll.
demo: Headline The Ultimate development studio, a studio blurb, and cards titled Moonbeam, Cursor, Rogue and others.
issues: Frames 4, 5 and 6 show long blank black stretches as the component scrolls away.
Card captions only appear on hover, so the photos read as anonymous.
The 300vh height leaves a lot of empty black space below the headline.
polishWhy: Striking tilted image wall behind a bold headline; the long scroll leaves blank gaps.
